buildingDesc_1671.en: It seems to be an array from the ancient times...
buildingDesc_1671.ch: 似乎是远古时期遗留至今的阵法…

buildingDesc_1681.en: Even from afar, you could feel the Qi emanating from the tree. There seems to be a number of spiritual fruits growing on it...
buildingDesc_1681.ch: 站在远处都能感受到此树散发的灵气，树上似乎结了不少灵果…

careerAssessDesc16.en: "We'd drink under blossoms and have a tipsy nap amid fragrance." You believe the path to immortality should be traveled together, and you proved it through Dual Cultivation.
careerAssessDesc16.ch: 酒醒只在花前坐，酒醉还来花下眠。于双修之中，你收益良多，终寻大道。

careerAssessDesc18.en: "We'll be forever at the other's side, like birds soaring together and branches growing entwined."
careerAssessDesc18.ch: 在天愿作比翼鸟,在地愿为连理枝。

careerAssessDesc26.en: "I know an extraordinary cultivator who's always willing to give materials to friends..." You are skilled in putting forward your requests; to your surprise, your tactic usually works.
careerAssessDesc26.ch: “恭喜发财，材料拿来”，开局伸个手，终成天上仙！ 你的事迹让人忍俊不禁，广为流传。

careerAssessDesc31.en: "Our arena is an open sea for the valiant to raise their sails of courage and venture into a world where only the most daring shall prevail!"
careerAssessDesc31.ch: 百舸争流千帆竞,借海扬帆奋者先！

careerAssessDesc32.en: "I'm here to clean up all evil!"

careerAssessDesc33.en: Read and travel - they are the two ways of understanding the world.

cautiousTacticScopeDes.en: The rate of attacks is reduced, and Elders must seek the Sect Leader's opinion on whether to launch an attack on an enemy's resource point.
cautiousTacticScopeDes.ch: 进攻的频率降低，并且长老对敌方资源点发动进攻时，需要询问宗主的意见。

dlc_skill_attack_desc41101.en: Press SPACE to cast. Unfold a violet canopy, gaining &41101_luckToAgile& Attack Speed from every Luck for &41101_netherField&s, cooldown: &41101_cd&s. All enemies will take damage over time from Nether Air, and their damage taken &41101_vulnerable&%. All Spirit Stones dropped inside the canopy have a &41101_manaMelt&% chance to melt, but a higher Luck will reduce the probability.
dlc_skill_attack_desc41101.ch: 点击空格释放，展开一片紫色领域，每点幸运转化为&41101_luckToAgile&点攻击速度，持续&41101_netherField&秒，冷却时间&41101_cd&秒。所有敌方单位持续受到冥气伤害，并且受到的伤害提升&41101_vulnerable&%。但领域内掉落的灵石将有&41101_manaMelt&%的概率被冥气消融掉（幸运越高，此概率越低）。

dlc_skill_attack_desc41102.en: Unfold a verdant canopy for &41102_flowerField&s, cooldown: &41102_cd&s. Restore &41102_hpRecover&% of Max Vitality per second for all units (including enemies) in it, and spawn devouring flowers inside the canopy to eat monsters and spit out their drops.
dlc_skill_attack_desc41102.ch: 展开一片绿色领域，持续&41102_flowerField&秒，冷却时间&41102_cd&秒。所有单位每秒回复&41102_hpRecover&%最大体力。在领域内召唤出食人花，食人花能吃掉附近的妖兽并吐出道具。

dlc_skill_attack_desc42101.en: Duplicate a random allied summoned unit and connect it for &42101_time&s. The summoned unit will gain a bonus Attack Speed equaling to Jagu's, and Jagu will gain a Vitality restoration equaling to 7% of the summoned unit's damage every time it attacks enemies. Cooldown: &42101_cd&s.
dlc_skill_attack_desc42101.ch: 随机复制一个友方召唤物并且与他们相连接，持续&42101_time&秒，连接后，召唤物将额外获得武罗的全部攻击速度加成，并且召唤物造成伤害时可为武罗吸血7%，冷却时间&42101_cd&秒。

dlc_skill_attack_desc42102.en: Grant all summoned units in the battlefield an additional Attack Speed and Crit Chance equal to yours for &42102_time&s.
dlc_skill_attack_desc42102.ch: 为场上所有己方召唤物附加自身的攻击速度和暴击率，持续&42102_time&秒。

dlc_skill_attack_desc43102.en: Press SPACE to cast. Gain &43102_ddslUp& extra Projectiles, &43102_jnscUp&% Skill Projectile Range, and &43102_agileUp&% Attack Speed in &43102_time&s.
dlc_skill_attack_desc43102.ch: 点击空格释放，&43102_time&秒内获得强化，弹道数量&43102_ddslUp&，技能弹道射程&43102_jnscUp&%，攻击速度&43102_agileUp&%。

dlc_skill_attack_desc45101.en: Charm &45101_enchantRate&% of the enemies (except for elite enemies and Mythical Beasts) on the battlefield. Enemies charmed will become your allies and will die after &45101_enchantTime&s. Cooldown: &45101_cd&s.
dlc_skill_attack_desc45101.ch: 魅惑场上&45101_enchantRate&%的敌人（精英怪、大妖兽除外），被魅惑的敌人会暂时成为友方单位，并在&45101_enchantTime&秒后死亡，该技能每&45101_cd&秒可使用一次。

dlc_skill_attack_desc46101.en: Dash forward after &46101_chargeTime&s of charging and knock enemies at your destination back. A full-charged cast of the skill will reset the Cooldown of other charge Skills. Cooldown: &46101_cd&s.
dlc_skill_attack_desc46101.ch: 蓄力&46101_chargeTime&秒后进行冲刺，冲刺后可击退周围的敌人，此技能蓄力满施放后，可刷新其它蓄力技能的CD，该技能每&46101_cd&秒可使用一次。

drama_kuafu4.en: When Agar's vitality is lower than <r>20</r>%, Agar's monthly move distance will decrease by 1.
drama_kuafu4.ch: 阿夸的精力小于<r>20</r>%时，每个月阿夸的移动距离<r>-1</r>。

drama_kuafu5.en: When Agar's vitality is larger than <g>20</g>%, Agar's monthly move distance will increase by 1.
drama_kuafu5.ch: 阿夸的精力大于<g>20</g>%时，每个月阿夸的移动距离<g>+1</g>。

drama_kuafu6.en: When Agar's vitality is larger than <g>40</g>%, Agar's monthly move distance will increase by 2.
drama_kuafu6.ch: 阿夸的精力大于<g>40</g>%时，每个月阿夸的移动距离<g>+2</g>。

elderSkillDesc23.en: In battle, every time you cast an Ultimate Skill, you'll trigger Gouchen's Bond, which generates a Soultrap Formation that lasts &27203_cxsj&/s at the target location. Enemies inside the Soultrap Formation can't cast any skills and receive &27203_shwl&/s damage. This damage's type matches your highest stat.
elderSkillDesc23.ch: 在战斗中，每次使用神通时可激发一次勾陈之缚，在目标位置产生一个锁灵阵，阵内的敌人受到牵引效果，无法使用任何技能，并对阵内的敌人造成威力为&27203_shwl&/秒的特长资质伤害，封印阵持续&27203_cxsj&秒。

elderSkillDesc3.en: In battle, after every (&27300_ljsh&% of your Max Vitality) damage you receive, you'll trigger Xuangui Shell, reducing incoming damage by a large amount for &27300_cxsj&s. This effect cannot occur more than once every &27300_nzcd&s.
elderSkillDesc3.ch: 在战斗中，每累计受到&27300_ljsh&%最大体力的伤害时，可激发一次玄龟之甲，在&27300_cxsj&秒内减免大量受到的伤害。此效果每&27300_nzcd&秒最多触发一次。

elderSkillDesc33.en: In battle, every time you receive damage more than &27303_sdsh&% of your Max Vitality, you'll trigger Xuangui's Roar, dealing &27303_shwl& damage to surrounding enemies and stunning them for &27303_yxsj&s. This damage's type matches your highest stat.
elderSkillDesc33.ch: 在战斗中，每次受到大于&27303_sdsh&%的最大体力的伤害时，可激发玄龟之吼，对周围的敌人造成威力&27303_shwl&的特长资质伤害，并使其晕眩&27303_yxsj&秒。

elderSkillDesc35.en: When Xuangui Shell is triggered, an earthquake will hit the entire battlefield, dropping boulders at random locations. Each boulder deals &27305_shwl& damage and stun the target for &27305_yxsj&s. This damage's type matches your highest stat.
elderSkillDesc35.ch: 在激发玄龟之甲时，还会引发全场地震，持续在全场的随机位置降下巨石，对命中的敌人造成威力&27305_shwl&的特长资质伤害，并使其晕眩&27305_yxsj&秒。

elderSkillDesc4.en: In battle, every time you use a Motion Skill, you'll increase your Agility by &27400_tsys& (up to &27400_tsys|x27400_djcs|f0&).
elderSkillDesc4.ch: 在战斗中，每使用一次身法，可提升&27400_tsys&点移动速度，最多可提升&27400_tsys|x27400_djcs|f0&点。

elderSkillDesc43.en: In battle, every time you cast a Motion Skill, you'll summon Luwu's Phantom. The phantom will attack any approaching enemy, dealing &27403_shwl&/s damage. This damage's type matches your highest stat. Affected enemies' Agility &27403_jdys&% for &27403_jssj&s.
elderSkillDesc43.ch: 在战斗中，每次使用身法时，可召唤一个陆吾幻像，幻像在有敌人靠近时，会自动扑向敌人，并造成威力&27403_shwl&/秒的特长资质伤害，并使其移动速度&27403_jdys&%，持续&27403_jssj&秒。

elderSkillDesc45.en: Every time Luwu's Phantom attacks an enemy, it has a &27405_cfgl&% chance to trigger Luwu's Charge, dealing &27405_cjsh& damage. This damage's type matches your highest stat. Affected enemies' Agility &27405_jdys&% for &27405_jssj&s.
elderSkillDesc45.ch: 陆吾幻像每次扑向敌人后，有&27405_cfgl&%的概率激发陆吾冲击，每次冲击对命中的敌人造成威力&27405_cjsh&的特长资质伤害，并使其移动速度&27405_jdys&%，持续&27405_jssj&秒。

elderSkillDesc5.en: Every time you enter a new room with less than &27500_tllj&% Vitality, you'll instantly restore &27500_hftl&% Vitality.
elderSkillDesc5.ch: 当进入一个新的房间时，若体力低于&27500_tllj&%，则可回复&27500_hftl&%的体力。

elderSkillDesc53.en: Every time you receive damage, you'll trigger Chongming Charge, dealing &27503_shwl& damage. This damage's type matches your highest stat. This effect cannot occur more than once every &27503_jncd&s.
elderSkillDesc53.ch: 当受到伤害时，可激发一次重明冲击，对命中的敌人造成威力&27503_shwl&的特长资质伤害，此效果每&27503_jncd&秒最多触发一次。

elderSkillDesc55.en: Chongming Charge also takes effect on allies. Every time it hits an ally, it'll restore the ally's Vitality by &27505_hftl&.
elderSkillDesc55.ch: 重明冲击还可命中友方单位，命中友方单位时，可使友方单位回复&27505_hftl&点体力。

fieldSkillDesc11.en: Every time an enemy inside the Field casts a skill, they'll receive &321001_jcsh& $s_dao$ damage. If this skill consumed Energy, the enemy will additionally receive (Energy consumed x&321001_cxsj&) $s_dao$ damage.
fieldSkillDesc11.ch: 领域内的敌人在每次使用技能时会受到&321001_jcsh&点$s_dao$伤害，且其使用技能若消耗了灵力，则会额外受到消耗灵力的&321001_cxsj&倍的$s_dao$伤害。

fieldSkillDesc111.en: Every time an enemy inside the Field receives damage from debuffs, they'll be inflicted with a stack of Melted Armor: Each stack of Melted Armor reduces DEF by &331001_jsfy& (up to &331001_djcs& stacks). When this Field Skill ends, all stacks of Scar will be removed from enemies.
fieldSkillDesc111.ch: 领域内的敌人在受到效果造成的伤害时，将获得一层熔甲效果（每一层可降低&331001_jsfy&点防御，最多可叠加&331001_djcs&层，领域技能结束时，也移除所有敌人身上的此效果）。

fieldSkillDesc112.en: Every time an ally (including yourself) inside the Field receives damage, they'll receive a stack of Trial by Fire: Every stack of Trial by Fire increases damage by &331002_tssh&% and restores &331002_hftl& Vitality every second for &331002_cxsj&s.
fieldSkillDesc112.ch: 领域内的友方单位（包括自身）每受到一次伤害时，可获得一层浴火效果（每一层可提升自身的伤害&331002_tssh&%，且每秒回复&331002_hftl&点体力，持续&331002_cxsj&秒）。

fieldSkillDesc113.en: Every time an ally (including yourself) inside the Field receives damage, they'll receive a stack of Trial by Fire: Every stack of Trial by Fire increases damage by &331003_tssh&% and restores &331003_hftl& Vitality every second for &331003_cxsj&s.
fieldSkillDesc113.ch: 领域内的友方单位（包括自身）每受到一次伤害时，可获得一层浴火效果（每一层可提升自身的伤害&331003_tssh&%，且每秒回复&331003_hftl&点体力，持续&331003_cxsj&秒）。

fieldSkillDesc12.en: You convert &321002_xxbl&% of damage done into your Vitality and increase the damage of all units (both allies and enemies) inside the Field by &321003_tssh&%.
fieldSkillDesc12.ch: 自身获得&321002_xxbl&%的吸血，并使领域内的所有单位（无论敌我），造成的伤害提升&321003_tssh&%。

fieldSkillDesc121.en: Every time an enemy inside the Field dies, you have a &332001_zhgl&% chance to summon a phantom of the dead enemy. The phantom moves and attacks automatically and dies after receiving &332001_sjcs& attacks.
fieldSkillDesc121.ch: 领域内的敌人死亡时，有&332001_zhgl&%的概率召唤一个敌人的幻像，幻像会自动移动和攻击，承受&332001_sjcs&次攻击后死亡。

handlekey_lianqi_shuoming.en: Press the specified button to destroy the energy ball, destroy the impurity ball and retain the purity ball, the higher the purity of the magic weapon refining success rate.
handlekey_lianqi_shuoming.ch: 按下指定按键可摧毁能量球，摧毁杂质球并保留纯度球，纯度越高法宝炼制成功率越高。

herdBattlelog1001.en: {1} appears at Wall No. {0}! Please go there and exterminate it!
herdBattlelog1001.ch: {0}号城墙惊现{1}，请仙盟顶尖战力速速前往，将其剿灭！

herdBattlelog1002.en: Nether Demons in Wall No. {0} are cleared by Alliance warriors!
herdBattlelog1002.ch: 在仙盟众人的齐心努力下，{0}号城墙的冥妖已被彻底斩杀！

herdBattlelog1003.en: {1} at Wall No. {0} was killed by {2}!
herdBattlelog1003.ch: 未曾想到，{0}号城墙的{1}竟已被{2}击杀！

herdBattlelog1004.en: {1} at Wall No. {0} has transformed into true form. A serious threat!
herdBattlelog1004.ch: {0}号城墙的{1}已然幻化真身，对仙盟产生严重威胁！

letterContent1001.en: I was defeated by {1} in {0}. Now, I'm on my last breath and need a {2} to reconstruct my body!
letterContent1001.ch: 我在{0}被{1}打败，并且肉身被毁，仅剩一丝游魂，需要一颗{2}才可重塑肉身！

letterContent201.en: 你身为本宗的{0}，理应要成为{1}之人，但你当前只是{2}，因你不注重自己的名誉，从而沾污了宗门之名望，作为惩戒，你本年的俸禄将减少{3}！
letterContent201.ch: 你身为本宗的{0}，理应要成为{1}之人，但你当前只是{2}，因你不注重自己的名誉，从而沾污了宗门之名望，作为惩戒，你本年的俸禄将减少{3}！

letterContent227.en:
{1}, I wish I could be seeing you in person like the letter.
We had went through a lot together, and I want to say goodbye before I leave.
I was once in a slump after the Tradition has recognized you as the Sect Leader.
I was envious, but I was actually more frustrated - that I was incapable as a Sect Leader.
I have decided to go venture the world. Rest assured, and see you then!
{0}
letterContent227.ch:
{1}，见信如面。
回想我们相识后的往事，在离开前还是决定向你辞别。
自从传承认可你为宗主以后，我确实一度有些消沉。
虽然心有不甘但更多的是对自己能力不足，未能尽好宗主之职的悔恨。
我打算外出游历一番，望君勿念，他日或许还会再见！
{0}

achievementDesc300031.en: Complete the game and win First Place in Sect Tournaments 20 times.
achievementDesc300031.ch: 通关且获得过宗门大比第一名20次

battle_dungeon_info3005.en: The core of the Mystic Realm is its most dangerous area. Ferocious monsters and harsh weather conditions will make your journey ahead extremely difficult—if not impossible.
battle_dungeon_info3005.ch: 秘境的中心区域，是整个秘境最危险的区域，不但有最强大的怪物出没，还有极端恶劣的气候，修为再强大的人都可能会寸步难行。

battle_dungeon_info3010.en: The core of the Mystic Realm is its most dangerous area. Ferocious monsters and harsh weather conditions will make your journey ahead extremely difficult—if not impossible.
battle_dungeon_info3010.ch: 秘境的中心区域，是整个秘境最危险的区域，不但有最强大的怪物出没，还有极端恶劣的气候，修为再强大的人都可能会寸步难行。

item_horse_desc_3011031.en: The Zouyu is a rarely-spotted legendary beast from the Lin Kingdom. It resembles a tiger, but with white fur and black patterns and a tail longer than its body. It is not a predator of living creatures and can walk over a thousand kilometers a day, making it an excellent mount.
item_horse_desc_3011031.ch: 驺吾是古代中国神话传说中的仁兽。林氏国一种十分珍贵的神兽，个体如老虎一般，身上有五彩斑斓的花纹，尾巴比身子要长，像白毛黑纹的虎，但不吃活的禽兽，很能走，骑上能日行千里。

item_horse_desc_8103221.en: The Tenghuang is a mystic beast. "The Nation of the White People is located to the north of where the Longyu can be found. The people there are white-skinned and long-haired. In the kingdom there's a beast called Tenghuang, which resembles a fox but with a horn on its back. Those who ride it shall live to two thousand years old." —Classic of Regions Beyond the Seas: West
item_horse_desc_8103221.ch: 乘黄是八荒世界传说中的异兽。《山海经·海外西经》：“白民之国在龙鱼北，白身披发。有乘黄，其状如狐，其背上有角，乘之寿二千岁。 ”

item_horse_desc_8103231.en: "To its north is the home of the Longyu. This fish resembles the common carp, though some say it's larger, with long whiskers." —Classic of Regions Beyond the Seas: West
item_horse_desc_8103231.ch: 《山海经·海外西经》：“龙鱼陵居在其北，状如貍。一曰鰕。”
